scope: bounded helper cleanup change; no real IR or flash LED writes

change.summary: Replaced the background sleep/watchdog child and blocking wait with the Android shell's one-second timed read. STOP, disconnect, timeout, and shell exit all reach the OFF write; a stalled transaction now exits after the timeout instead of leaving its connection worker blocked.

phone_shell.device: Lumia 950 XL cityman, Android 16, serial d7baece4
phone_shell.timed_read_support: confirmed with /system/bin/sh using a piped STOP line
phone_shell.stop_case: PULSE then STOP returned ON and OFF; fake brightness ended at 0
phone_shell.stall_case: PULSE without STOP timed out, returned ON and OFF, and fake brightness ended at 0

limits: This verifies shell transaction cleanup against a fake brightness file, not optical LED latency or emitter safety.
The one-second software timeout is not an eye-safety limit.
publication: local only; no commit, push, or PR
